title: Teased into Trance at the Game Store
description:
This is for the trading card game fans! If you’re a TCG player, or even if you’re not, I think the idea of sitting down for a round of your favourite game and meeting a cute, sexy girl in your opponent is a fun one, right!

Except this girl, she doesn’t really know the game… or any trading card game. But she does know femdom, and hot girls on cards, and hypnosis. And if you keep listening to her as you play your game, you might just fall into a trance and feel the power of her femdom hypno weaving magic upon your mind!

Can you resist this Dark Magician Girl, or will you have a Change of Heart and fall for her? It’s time to D-D-D-D-Duel!
